subject: Economy
sub_topic: Per capita income and purchasing power parity

concepts.name: Per Capita Income: Definition, Calculation and Limitations
key_dimensions: Formula: National Income / Total Population and distinction between nominal vs. real per capita income
Limitation as a welfare measure: ignores income distribution, inequality (Gini coefficient trap)
Why high per capita income countries may have poor HDI rankings (Gulf states trap)
Difference between per capita NNP at factor cost vs. per capita GDP at market prices

concepts.name: Purchasing Power Parity (PPP): Concept and Law of One Price
key_dimensions: Theoretical foundation: Law of One Price and its extension to PPP
Absolute PPP vs. Relative PPP — distinction and conditions under which each holds
Why PPP rates diverge from market exchange rates (non-tradable goods, transport costs, trade barriers)
The 'Big Mac Index' as a popular illustration of PPP — its strengths and criticisms

concepts.name: PPP vs. Market Exchange Rate (MER): Conceptual Differences and UPSC Traps
key_dimensions: Why developing countries appear larger/richer under PPP than under MER (non-tradable services are cheaper)
IMF and World Bank use PPP for international comparisons — reasons and implications
India's GDP rank changes significantly between MER-based and PPP-based calculations
When MER is preferred over PPP (trade analysis, debt servicing, forex transactions)

concepts.name: International Comparison Program (ICP) and PPP Estimation
key_dimensions: Role of World Bank's ICP in calculating PPP conversion factors across countries
Benchmark years and revision cycles (2011 ICP, 2017 ICP) — India's rank shifts between revisions
Methodological challenges: selecting comparable basket of goods across diverse economies
How ICP results affect India's poverty headcount and global poverty lines

concepts.name: India's GDP Ranking: PPP vs. Nominal Basis
key_dimensions: India as 3rd largest economy (PPP) vs. 5th largest (nominal MER) — current standings
Why the gap exists: large informal sector, cheaper services, lower price levels in India
Policy implication: PPP ranking used to argue for greater voice in multilateral institutions (IMF quota reform)
UPSC trap: conflating 'largest economy' claims — context of which measure is being used

concepts.name: PPP and Global Poverty Line
key_dimensions: World Bank's International Poverty Line ($2.15/day at 2017 PPP) — basis and revisions
Why poverty lines are expressed in PPP dollars, not nominal dollars
Impact of ICP 2011 vs. 2017 revisions on India's poverty headcount estimates
Distinction between World Bank poverty line and India's domestic poverty line (Tendulkar, Rangarajan)

concepts.name: Human Development Index (HDI) and Its Relationship with Per Capita Income
key_dimensions: HDI uses GNI per capita at PPP (not GDP) — UPSC frequently tests this distinction
Three dimensions of HDI: health, education, income — per capita income is only one component
Countries with high per capita income but low HDI (resource-rich states) vs. high HDI but moderate income (Kerala model)
UNDP's shift from GDP to GNI per capita in HDI calculation (post-2010 revision)

concepts.name: GNI per Capita at PPP vs. GDP per Capita: Definitional Precision
key_dimensions: GNI = GDP + Net Factor Income from Abroad — relevance for remittance-dependent economies
Why UNDP uses GNI per capita (not GDP per capita) in HDI — captures citizens' actual income
Countries where GNI >> GDP (large diaspora remittances: Philippines, Bangladesh, India) vs. GNI << GDP (tax havens: Ireland, Luxembourg)
UPSC trap: HDI income component stated incorrectly as 'GDP per capita' in options

concepts.name: Penn World Tables and Alternative PPP Databases
key_dimensions: Penn World Tables (PWT) vs. World Bank WDI — differences in methodology and coverage
Geary-Khamis (GK) method vs. EKS method for multilateral PPP comparisons
Why different PPP databases yield different rankings — index number problem
Use of PWT in academic research vs. ICP data in policy applications

concepts.name: Balassa-Samuelson Effect: Why Poor Countries Have Lower Price Levels
key_dimensions: Mechanism: productivity differences in tradable sector drive price level differences across countries
Explains why PPP-based incomes of developing countries are systematically higher than MER-based incomes
Implication for exchange rate policy: real exchange rate appreciation as countries develop
UPSC angle: theoretical justification for why India's PPP GDP > nominal GDP

concepts.name: Per Capita Income and Income Inequality: Distributional Blind Spots
key_dimensions: Per capita income as arithmetic mean — sensitivity to outliers (billionaires distorting average)
Median income vs. mean income as better welfare indicators — why UPSC tests this distinction
Kuznets curve: inverted-U relationship between per capita income and inequality
India's case: rising per capita income alongside widening Gini coefficient — policy contradiction

concepts.name: Real vs. Nominal Per Capita Income and Deflation
key_dimensions: Deflating nominal per capita income using GDP deflator vs. CPI — which is appropriate when
Base year effect: India's GDP series rebasing (2004-05 to 2011-12) and impact on per capita income growth rates
Purchasing power erosion: inflation reduces real per capita income even if nominal rises
UPSC trap: questions conflating growth in nominal per capita income with improvement in living standards

concepts.name: PPP and International Trade Analysis: When PPP Fails
key_dimensions: PPP assumes price equalization through arbitrage — fails for non-tradable goods and services
Harrod-Balassa-Samuelson effect as systematic deviation from PPP
Short-run vs. long-run validity of PPP — empirical evidence
Why current account balances and trade competitiveness should use MER, not PPP

concepts.name: Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) vs. Per Capita Income as Poverty Measures
key_dimensions: UNDP-OPHI MPI: 10 indicators across 3 dimensions — goes beyond income-based poverty
India's NITI Aayog National MPI: methodology and recent findings on poverty reduction
Why per capita income rise doesn't automatically reduce MPI (non-income deprivations persist)
UPSC trap: distinguishing between World Bank poverty headcount (income-based) and MPI (multidimensional)

concepts.name: State-Level Per Capita Income Disparities in India
key_dimensions: High per capita GSDP states (Goa, Sikkim, Telangana) vs. low per capita states (Bihar, UP) — regional divergence
15th Finance Commission's use of per capita income distance criterion for horizontal devolution
Special Category Status rationale partly based on low per capita income — J&K reorganization implications
UPSC angle: per capita income as one of the criteria in Finance Commission's devolution formula

concepts.name: Limitations of PPP for Policy Comparison: Health, Education and Infrastructure
key_dimensions: PPP adjusts for price levels but not for quality differences in public services
Healthcare and education spending comparisons across countries: PPP-adjusted vs. percentage of GDP
Why PPP comparisons can be misleading for capital goods and technology imports
OECD's critique of PPP for comparing government expenditure efficiency across nations

concepts.name: Current Account Balance and PPP: IMF's Use of PPP Weights in WEO
key_dimensions: IMF World Economic Outlook uses PPP weights for aggregating global GDP growth — implications for India's weight
Why global recession depth appears different under PPP-weighted vs. MER-weighted aggregation
China's share in world GDP: ~18% (PPP) vs. ~17% (nominal) — geopolitical significance
India's share in world GDP under PPP (~7%) vs. MER (~3.5%) — used in G20 leadership narrative

concepts.name: Engel's Law and Per Capita Income: Consumption Pattern Shifts
key_dimensions: Engel's Law: as per capita income rises, proportion spent on food falls — income elasticity < 1 for food
Application in India: NSSO/HCES data showing shift from food to non-food expenditure over decades
Implication for poverty measurement: calorie-based poverty lines become inadequate at higher income levels
UPSC angle: Engel curve analysis used to validate per capita income growth through consumption data

concepts.name: PPP and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): Monitoring Framework
key_dimensions: SDG 1 (No Poverty) monitoring uses PPP-based international poverty lines — $2.15/day threshold
SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities) uses Palma ratio and Gini alongside per capita income trends
Why PPP revisions (2011 to 2017 ICP) changed countries' SDG poverty progress assessments
India's official position on World Bank poverty line vs. domestic poverty estimation methodology

concepts.name: Gross National Happiness (GNH) and Beyond-GDP Measures vs. Per Capita Income
key_dimensions: Bhutan's GNH index as alternative to per capita income — four pillars and nine domains
OECD Better Life Index, Genuine Progress Indicator (GPI) — subtracting social/environmental costs from GDP
Stiglitz-Sen-Fitoussi Commission recommendations on measuring economic performance beyond GDP
UPSC angle: India's initiatives toward inclusive wealth accounting — Green GDP and natural capital
